Question: On writing messages to our friends on phone is it necessary to do salam.if yes thn in what format cause people use many shortcuts like a/a or aoa or simple salam.wht abt darood on top aftr's ALLAH NAme.what we should mention. Answer ID: 8034 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1881/1571=B/1429) It is better to greet even over the phone before starting talks, and one should greet with the words which are mentioned in the Hadith. While sending a message to a friend you can also send 'salam', but one should not write the complete words of salam , durood and bismillah in mobile messages in order to avoid desecration to the Quran and Hadith. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
